title: 第4章
content_zh:
自己去街对面的饭店买了炒饭回来吃，想着等李巍回来一定要和他谈一谈，如果真的有问题那么他们应该一起去面对解决，决不能让李巍感到一丝的不自在。
下午屋里被窗外的阳光晒得暖洋洋的，夏真钰有些犯困便回卧室睡觉，也不知道睡了多长时间就听门外有动静，好像有人在开门锁，她一激灵坐了起来，仔细的听了听，确实有人在大门外开锁。
夏真玉有些害怕了，这楼是一梯两户，全楼不过２０几户人家，而且对面好像也是小两口带个孩子，这时候也都上班的上班，上学的上学了，自己家里还没来得急安电话，而且还是１２楼这要是真有坏人自己还真没处求救。
不对，还有手机啊，夏真钰腿有些发软，扑腾着下了床跑到客厅慌乱的找着手机，找了半天也没看着，昨天那么乱真没印象手机放哪了。这时咔嚓一声门外的锁开了，夏真钰什么也顾不得了，赶紧往卧室跑，想着进了卧室再把门锁上还能再拖延一会儿。
刚跑到卧室门口，后面就传来了李巍他妈的声音：真钰，你睡着啦。我刚才在外面敲门你都没听到，我以为没人呢，也不熟悉哪个是大门钥匙，弄了半天才
夏真钰的心一下落了地，吓死她了，害怕过后却是气愤，她和李巍新婚第一天，她这个做婆婆的不避讳的跑来做什么，而且还有家门钥匙，这以后还有隐私吗。
忍了气转过身，努力笑了下说道：妈，你怎么过来了。我刚才睡得有些实了，真没听到您敲门，只听见有人开锁，吓我一跳以为有坏人呢。
宋娟呵呵一笑说：你这新婚第一天，觉得累也是正常的，这屋子的钥匙我这有一份，李巍他姥姥那还有一份。我这份呢是平时你们不在家时我过来帮你们打扫打扫，他姥姥那留一份是怕万一有个紧急情况什么的备用。
紧接着又说：我过来是让你们到我那去吃饭，晚饭我已经做好了。李巍呢？还睡觉呢？
夏真钰没办只好编个理由：哦，李巍刚才还在家呢，他单位领导突然来电话说有个急活儿李巍就赶过去了。
宋娟生怕夏真钰不高兴李巍出去连忙说道：这孩子新婚就把媳妇自己扔家真不懂事，真钰你别挑他，你也知道他就是个老实人不会拒绝别人。这个领导也是，怎么不通人情呢。
夏真钰说：没事的妈，现在说来还是李巍的工作比较重要，我换下衣服就和你去吃饭。
换了衣服去了婆婆家，离得非常近就隔了一栋楼，李巍爸爸也在家正看电视呢，看见夏真钰进来高兴的打了招呼，也跟着埋怨了一阵子李巍。
宋娟做的菜味道特别淡，几乎没放什么调料，夏真钰有些吃不惯，但也勉强吃了一碗饭，她深知婆媳关系的微妙，怕宋娟嫌她嘴娇。
宋娟看她光吃饭不吃菜，便说道：是不是不合胃口？李巍他爸血压高，以前还突发过一次脑血栓，还好恢复得不错，没什么后遗症，所以平时饮食得清淡些。你要吃不惯，以后等你们过来时我再单做。
夏真钰也觉得挺不好意思的便说道：妈，不用了。将来我学着做饭，平时我们就多来看看你们，陪你们聊聊天。
李巍爸爸听了，一个劲儿的点头笑，李巍妈白了他一眼，也笑了笑没说什么，夏真钰不会做饭这是一开始和李巍交往时就知道的，当初还有点不满意。不过既然现在她说肯学，那么早晚也就会了，不管如何他儿子每天能吃上热乎饭就行。
夏真钰又坐了一会儿就回去了，开了门看见客厅的灯亮着，知道李巍回来了。换了鞋看见李巍看新闻呢，茶几上摆了几厅啤酒和一些卤菜什么的，正喝着呢。
她走过去坐在李巍旁边问：什么时候回来的？
李巍双眼只看盯着电视看，然后说：不到二十分钟吧，你出去了？

嗯，妈过来让我去吃晚饭，吃完又聊了会儿天。
说完两人便再没什么话题了，夏真钰怕他不自在就去了书房打电脑玩了会游戏，也没玩进去，便换了睡衣准备睡觉。
她在床上想等李巍进来时和他说说两人的事情，结果快凌晨１点时李巍才带着酒气躺了上来，没一会便鼾声大作了，她叹了口气只好做罢。
第二天早上李巍招呼也没打直接就去单位了，夏真钰只好每天找事做，收拾屋子，洗衣服然后去附近的超市解决三餐，李巍又是很晚才回家，每次都等她上床一段时间后才进卧室。
第三天回门时，两人在夏真钰爸妈面前表现得若无其事，之后就又恢复了先前的生活，期间李巍他妈又来过几次让她过去吃饭，她都推拒了。就这样，一星期的婚假很快过去了，她也没找到机会同李巍谈。
周一夏真钰带了包好的喜糖去了单位上班，同事们看着她大惊小怪的说：真钰，你不是没去度蜜月吗？怎么又瘦了，脸色也不好。
夏真钰真是无话可说，有苦难言，只好说不太适应婚后的生活，而且上班也太远了有些犯愁，同事听了也纷纷说上班还是家近点好，不然就是遭罪，现在天气还好，等到了冬天那才真是活受罪呢。
在单位和夏真钰关系很好的王姐趁没人的时候偷偷问她：真钰，我看你一点也没新媳妇的喜气，是不是有什么事？有事就和王姐说，看能不能帮什么忙？
夏真钰的眼泪差点让王姐的话给逼出来，她现在的状况真的只能自己想办法、自己承受，对谁也不能说，于是勉强笑了下说：没事儿，王姐，你放心吧，就是不太习惯，过段时间就好了。
王姐也没再多问，只叮嘱她注意身体。下午的时候夏真钰单位的一把书记和主任突然召开了领导班子紧急会议，吩咐下来会没开完谁都不能下班，大家都嘀咕不知道又有什么破事儿，非得下班的时候布置，周一本来就倦怠，结果还回不了家。
夏真钰倒是没什么，虽然家远了点，但一想到面对李巍还不如加班呢。下班时间已经过了半小时了，这时领导班子成员全下楼来了，告诉大家立即准备，区长一会儿就到。
区长这时候来做什么，所有的人都有些摸不着头脑，不过答案很快就揭晓了。区长离开后，领导班子又召开了全体人员会议，内容就是明天副市长要来他们办事大厅视察工作，今天必须把明天的接待工作准备好，不允许出任何差错。
副市长好几个呢，中央的、省里的领导也没少来他们这视察也没看这么紧张啊，夏真钰好奇的问了旁边的王姐。
王姐笑了，说道：你还真是个不好打听的，你以为说的是哪个副市长呢？明天来的是周瑾宇周市长！
作者有话要说：麻烦审核人员看看清楚呗，已经改得什么都不剩了，还锁啊。唉，真不知道河蟹的底限在哪啊，这章也没写什么出格的呀，改了三、四次了还锁，还让不让人活了。
☆、温文尔雅的周瑾宇？
作者有话要说：如以后章节还会被锁请大家点击作者的名字进入光光的专栏，那里有解决办法。
听了王姐的话，夏真钰回答道：周市长我知道啊，全市人民都知道啊，空降部队，帅哥一枚，还不到４０岁吧，牛人一个。
王姐白了她一眼：你还不知道上面为什么这重视啊？我半个月前可就听说了，周瑾宇虽说是副市长，可是个实权人物，握着全市大小官员的生杀大权呢。要是别的什么领导也就那么回事了，不过要是让周瑾宇不满意了，丢官都是有可能的。
这么严重啊，夏真钰倒没什么感觉，反正和她关系不大，她也没编制，也没可能升职加薪，所以再大的领导也与她没利益关系。

由于要加班，办公室主任给大家订了盒饭，准备吃完开始加班，夏真钰给李巍打了个电话，告诉他今晚可能会加班到很晚，如果太晚了她就直接回娘家住一宿。
李巍听了以后，让夏真钰晚上回家时注意安全，打车记下车牌号，到家给再给他打电话或者发个短信什么的，嘱咐得很是仔细。
夏真钰听出了李巍关心背后的轻松，也许这阵子李巍看到自己会压力更大吧，还是给他点时间想想吧，自己多给他点自由的空间，放松了心理压力就会减轻许多，对他生理也有帮助。
真钰，加完班你家小李来接你吗？王姐过来问。
夏真钰回答道：哦，不用他接的，我回我妈家住一宿，明天还得提早上班太远了折腾人。
王姐点了点头又说：刚才各科室领了任务，我们科就是要检查系统数据，明天周市长看实际操作时不能出一点纰漏。
夏真钰是知道这个系统的，其实这个软件平台从构思到构建都是周瑾宇提出来并着手实践的，主要作用就是将来整个市政机构将要实现数字化办公，从而节省人力物力资源并提高政府机构的办事效率，这个系统试运行以来得到了市民的广泛好评，新闻媒体也多次进行了报道。
但这并不是最终目的，夏真钰因为多年在机关单位里混，也明白这数字化背后意味着优胜劣汰，既然节省了人力和物力那么当然就要裁下去一部分人，那些不思进取，不能掌握现代化办公技术的、没有一定工作能力的人，还有那些成天无所事事的闲人肯定是要被发落的，这就是变相的体制改革，肯定要触及一部分人的核心利益。
所以全市各机构从上到下都极度重视这项由周瑾宇亲自主持的工作，生怕一个疏忽丢了乌纱帽，而这项工程据说也得了到中＼央的大力支持，如果在本市试验成功还要向全国推广。
content_en:
I went to the restaurant across the street to buy fried rice and came back to eat, thinking that I would have to talk to Li Wei when he came back. If there was really a problem, then they should face it together and solve it, and never make Li Wei feel uncomfortable at all.
In the afternoon, the room was warmed by the sunshine outside the window. Xia Zhenyu felt a little sleepy and went back to the bedroom to sleep. She didn't know how long she slept when she heard movement outside the door. It seemed like someone was unlocking the door. She sat up in excitement and listened carefully. Someone was indeed unlocking the door.
Xia Zhenyu was a little scared. There were two households on one floor, and there were only about 20 households in the whole building. Moreover, there seemed to be a young couple with a child across the street. People were working and going to school at this time. He didn't even have to call the emergency department at home, and it was still on the 12th floor. If there was really a bad guy, he would have nowhere to call for help.
No, there is a mobile phone. Xia Zhenyu's legs felt a little weak. He jumped out of bed and ran to the living room to look for the mobile phone in a panic. He looked for it for a long time without looking at it. It was so chaotic yesterday that he couldn't remember where he put his mobile phone. At this moment, there was a click and the lock outside the door opened. Xia Zhenyu couldn't care about anything and hurried to the bedroom, thinking that locking the door after entering the bedroom would delay it for a while.
As soon as he ran to the bedroom door, Li Wei's voice came from behind: Zhenyu, you are asleep. You didn't hear me knocking on the door just now. I thought no one was there, and I wasn't familiar with which key was which. It took me a long time to do it.
Xia Zhenyu's heart dropped to the ground. She was scared to death, but after the fear, she was angry. On the first day of her wedding to Li Wei, she, a mother-in-law, did not shy away from doing anything, and she also had the key to the house. Will there be privacy in the future?
After enduring his anger, he turned around, tried his best to smile and said, "Mom, why are you here?" I was sleeping a little bit just now. I really didn't hear you knocking on the door. I only heard someone unlocking the door. I was startled and thought there was a bad guy.
Song Juan chuckled and said, "It's normal for you to feel tired on your first day of marriage. I have one share of the key to this house, and Li Wei and his grandma have another share." My share is for me to come over and help you clean when you are not at home, and his grandma keeps one as a backup in case of an emergency or something.
Then he said: I came here to let you come to my place for dinner. I have already prepared dinner. Where is Li Wei? Still sleeping?
Xia Zhenyu had no choice but to make up an excuse: Oh, Li Wei was at home just now. The leader of his unit suddenly called and said that there was an urgent job, so Li Wei rushed over.
Song Juan was afraid that Xia Zhenyu would be unhappy. Li Wei went out and said quickly: "This kid is so ignorant that he abandons his wife at home just after they get married. Zhenyu, don't pick on him. You also know that he is an honest person and will not refuse others." The same goes for this leader, why is he so unreasonable?
Xia Zhenyu said: It's okay, Mom. Li Wei's work is more important now. I'll change my clothes and go have dinner with you.
I changed my clothes and went to my mother-in-law's house. It was very close to her, just one building away. Li Wei's father was also watching TV at home. When he saw Xia Zhenyu coming in, he happily greeted him and complained to Li Wei for a while.
The food made by Song Juan was very bland, with almost no seasoning. Xia Zhenyu was a little uncomfortable with it, but she managed to eat a bowl of rice. She was well aware of the delicate relationship between mother-in-law and daughter-in-law, and was afraid that Song Juan would find her coquettish.
Song Juan saw that she was only eating without eating vegetables, so she said: Is it not to your liking? Li Wei's father has high blood pressure and had a cerebral thrombosis before. Fortunately, he recovered well and had no sequelae, so he usually eats a lighter diet. If you can't get used to it, I'll cook it alone when you come over.
Xia Zhenyu also felt quite embarrassed and said: Mom, no need. In the future, I will learn to cook, and we will visit you more often and chat with you.
Li Wei's father listened and nodded and smiled. Li Wei's mother rolled her eyes at him and smiled without saying anything. She knew Xia Zhenyu couldn't cook when she first started dating Li Wei. She was a little dissatisfied at first. But sinceNow that she is willing to learn, she will be able to do it sooner or later. No matter what, as long as her son can eat hot meals every day.
Xia Zhenyu sat for a while and then went back. When he opened the door and saw the light in the living room was on, he knew that Li Wei was back. After changing my shoes, I saw Li Wei watching the news. There were several beers and some braised vegetables on the coffee table, and he was drinking them.
She walked over and sat next to Li Wei and asked: When did you come back?
Li Wei only stared at the TV, and then said: It's been less than twenty minutes, are you out?
Well, mom came over and asked me to have dinner, and we chatted for a while after dinner.
After that, the two of them had nothing to talk about. Xia Zhenyu was afraid that he would be uncomfortable, so he went to the study room to play games on the computer for a while, but he didn't get into the game, so he changed into pajamas and got ready to go to bed.
She was waiting for Li Wei to come in and talk to him about the two of them, but it was almost 1 o'clock in the morning when Li Wei lay down smelling of alcohol. After a while, he started snoring loudly, so she sighed and had to give up.
The next morning, Li Wei went to work without even saying hello. Xia Zhenyu had to find things to do every day, clean the house, do laundry and go to the nearby supermarket for meals. Li Wei came home very late again, and always waited for her to go to bed for a while before entering the bedroom.
When they returned home on the third day, the two acted as if nothing had happened in front of Xia Zhenyu's parents, and then resumed their previous lives. During this period, Li Wei's mother came several times to ask her to come over for dinner, but she refused. In this way, the one-week wedding leave passed quickly, and she did not find a chance to talk to Li Wei.
On Monday, Xia Zhenyu brought the wrapped wedding candies to work. Her colleagues looked at her and said in a fuss: Zhenyu, didn't you go on your honeymoon? Why have I lost weight again and my complexion doesn't look good?
Xia Zhenyu really had nothing to say, and she had no choice but to say that she was not used to the life after marriage, and that it was too far to go to work. Her colleagues also said that it would be better to work closer to home, otherwise they would suffer. The weather is fine now, but it would be really painful in winter.
Sister Wang, who had a good relationship with Xia Zhenyu at work, secretly asked her when no one was around: Zhenyu, I see you don't have the joy of a new wife at all. Is there something wrong? If you need anything, just tell Sister Wang and see if you can help her in any way.
Xia Zhenyu almost burst into tears because of Sister Wang's words. She really had to find a solution and bear her current situation by herself, and she couldn't tell anyone, so she forced a smile and said: It's okay, Sister Wang, don't worry, I'm just not used to it, it will get better after a while.
Sister Wang didn't ask any more questions and just told her to pay attention to her health. In the afternoon, the secretary and director of Xia Zhenyu's unit suddenly held an emergency meeting of the leadership team, and ordered that no one should get off work before the meeting was over. Everyone was muttering that they didn't know what happened, and they had to arrange it when they got off work. I was already tired on Monday, but I couldn't go home.
Xia Zhenyu was fine. Although his home was a little far away, he might as well work overtime when he thought of facing Li Wei. It was already half an hour after get off work. At this time, all members of the leadership team came downstairs and told everyone to prepare immediately. The district chief would be here soon.
Everyone was a little confused as to what the district mayor was doing at this time, but the answer was soon revealed. After the district mayor left, the leadership team held a meeting of all personnel. The content was that the deputy mayor would come to their office hall to inspect the work tomorrow. The reception work for tomorrow must be prepared today, and no mistakes were allowed.
There were several deputy mayors, and leaders from the central and provincial governments came to inspect them. They didn't seem so nervous. Xia Zhenyu curiously asked Sister Wang next to him.
Sister Wang smiled and said: You are really hard to inquire about. Which deputy mayor do you think you are talking about? Coming tomorrow is Mayor Zhou Jinyu!

☆. The gentle Zhou Jinyu?

After listening to Sister Wang's words, Xia Zhenyu replied: Mayor Zhou, I know it, and everyone in the city knows it. He is an airborne trooper. He is a handsome guy. He is not even 40 years old. He is a great guy.
Sister Wang rolled her eyes at her: "You still don't know why the higher-ups pay so much attention to it?" I heard about it half a month ago. Although Zhou Jinyu is the deputy mayor, he is a real powerful figure and holds the power of life and death for officials of all sizes in the city. It would be the same for any other leader, but if Zhou Jinyu is dissatisfied, he may lose his position.
It was so serious. Xia Zhenyu didn't feel anything about it. Anyway, it had little to do with her. She didn't have a staff, and she couldn't get a promotion or a salary increase, so no matter how big the boss was, she had no interest in it.
Since they had to work overtime, the office director ordered lunch boxes for everyone and was about to start working overtime after eating. Xia Zhenyu called Li Wei and told him that he might work overtime until very late tonight. If it was too late, she would go directly back to her parents' house to stay overnight.
After hearing this, Li Wei asked Xia Zhenyu to pay attention to safety when he went home at night, take a taxi and write down the license plate number, and call him or send him a text message when he got home. He was very careful.
Xia Zhenyu could hear the relief behind Li Wei's concern. Maybe Li Wei would be more stressed now that he saw himself. It would be better to give him some time to think about it. Give him more free space. Relaxing the psychological pressure will reduce a lot, and it will also help his physiology.
Zhenyu, will your Xiao Li pick you up after overtime? Sister Wang came over and asked.
Xia Zhenyu replied: Oh, he doesn't need to pick it up. I'll go back to my mother's house and stay overnight. I have to go to work early tomorrow because it's too far.
Sister Wang nodded and said: Each department just received a task, and our department is to check the system data. Tomorrow, Mayor Zhou will see the actual operation without making any mistakes.
Xia Zhenyu knew about this system. In fact, this software platform was proposed and put into practice by Zhou Jinyu from conception to construction. Its main function is to realize digital office work in the entire municipal agencies in the future, thereby saving human and material resources and improving the efficiency of government agencies. Since its trial operation, this system has been widely praised by citizens and has been reported by the news media many times.
But this is not the ultimate goal. Because Xia Zhenyu has been working in government agencies for many years, he also understands that digitization means survival of the fittest. Since manpower and material resources are saved, some people must be laid off. Those who are not enterprising, cannot master modern office technology, do not have certain work ability, and those who have nothing to do all day long will definitely be punished. This is a disguised system reform, which will definitely touch the core interests of some people.
Therefore, all agencies in the city attach great importance to this work, which is personally presided over by Zhou Jinyu, from top to bottom, for fear that an oversight will cause the project to lose its reputation. It is said that this project has also received strong support from the central government, and if it is successfully tested in this city, it will be promoted nationwide.
